decisions.H274_annotation_adds_beyond_identity: not assessable - baseline is worse than chance

limits: Even 60 repeats per layout draws held-out cells with replacement, so units are not independent.
Each drug still has only a few concentration points.
Retrospective; no mechanism, clinical or drug-choice claim; no meta-learning or RSI.

reproduction_check.meaning: the pipeline is unchanged and only the identity arm was added, which is exactly what the 'change one thing at a time' rule was meant to guarantee

the_identity_arm_is_degenerate.reading: identity scores far BELOW the 25% chance level, so it is anti-predictive of the additivity residual. The additive null already absorbs per-drug intercepts and dose slopes, so what remains for identity to fit is approximately noise, and the ranking ends up inverted.
the_identity_arm_is_degenerate.consequence: 'gene beats identity by 18.25 pp' is NOT evidence for annotation value, because the identity baseline is worse than chance; beating a broken baseline proves nothing

what_remains_unestablished.note: this is exactly the R89 result and still does not exclude zero
